rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now the rook has two knights to help. With them, your king does not even need to come close.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Count the black king's squares: the knight on e6 attacks g7, and the knight on g5 attacks h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Only the last rank is left to close, with a rook check.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! The rook closes the last rank, and the knights guard g7 and h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to a8 and checks along the edge. Every escape square is taken.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.1: The rook on the seventh cuts the king off, but gives no check, and g8 is free.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.2: The black king goes to g8.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a7.3: Let's go back: the right check is along the last rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: each knight takes one square, and the rook closes the edge.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The e6 knight already guards g7. If the rook checks now, the black king escapes through h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Take the other knight to a square that attacks h7, but leave g8 free: without check, the king needs a move.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Prepare the mate with a knight, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! From g5, the knight attacks h7. The black king only has g8.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The knight jumps to g5 and attacks h7. The black king is left with only g8.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.1: It is check, but h7 is still free.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.2: The black king escapes to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.3: Let's go back: first the knight, then the rook.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e4f6.1: Careful! From f6, the knight takes g8 and h7 without check. Stalemate!
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e4f6.2: Let's go back: leave one free square for the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not prepare the mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Prepare the mate with a knight, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to g8, its only square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Checkmate! The g5 knight guards f7 and h7, and the e6 knight guards g7 and f8.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show another way, the Arabian mate, and a danger: stalemate.
rot.demos.arabe.e1: From the same position, another way: the rook goes to the seventh, and a knight protects it.
rot.demos.arabe.l1: The rook goes to the seventh. The black king is cut off on the last rank.
rot.demos.arabe.l2: The black king goes to g8, its only square.
rot.demos.arabe.l3: The knight jumps to f6 and gives check. The e6 knight takes f8.
rot.demos.arabe.l4: The black king only has h8.
rot.demos.arabe.l5: Checkmate! It is the Arabian mate: the f6 knight protects the rook and guards g8.
rot.demos.afogamento.e1: Now a danger. The rook and the e6 knight guard g7 and h7. Only g8 is left.
rot.demos.afogamento.l1: If the e4 knight went to f6, it would take g8 without check. The king would have no move: stalemate.
rot.demos.afogamento.l2: Instead of f6, the knight goes to g5: it takes h7 and f7, and leaves g8 free.
rot.demos.afogamento.l3: The black king goes to g8.
rot.demos.afogamento.l4: Checkmate! The knights guard the seventh, and the rook closes the edge.
rot.demos.afogamento.l5: Now it's your turn: cut the king off with the rook, take squares with the knights and count the escapes.
rot.pratica.preparar.enunciado: Give checkmate. The black king has a7 and b8. Attack a7 with a knight and leave b8 free.
rot.pratica.preparar.fim: Perfect. The knight took a7, and the rook gave mate.
rot.pratica.preparar.err.h1h8: It is check, but the king escapes through a7. Try again.
rot.pratica.preparar.err.d4c6: Careful: the black king has no move and is not in check. It is stalemate.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: The black king is in the center. Cut it off on a rank with the rook and bring the knights close.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Well done. You knew how to use the two knights.
